concepts.name: Card
concepts.definition: A unique printing of a Magic card, identified by fld001.

concepts.name: CardName
concepts.definition: The printed name of a card.

concepts.name: BorderColor
concepts.definition: The border style/color of the card face.

concepts.name: BorderlessCard
concepts.definition: A card whose border is borderless.

concepts.name: Power
concepts.definition: The power value of a creature card; '*' or NULL means unknown/infinite.

concepts.name: UnknownPowerCard
concepts.definition: A card whose power is '*' or NULL.

concepts.name: InfinitePowerCard
concepts.definition: A card whose power is '*'.

concepts.name: PromotionalPrinting
concepts.definition: Flag indicating the card is a promotional printing.

concepts.name: FrameStyle
concepts.definition: The frame style of the card.

concepts.name: TextBoxFlag
concepts.definition: Flag indicating presence of a text box (0 = no text box).
aliases: do not have a text box

concepts.name: StorySpotlight
concepts.definition: Flag indicating the card is a Story Spotlight card.
concepts.filter: fld001 IS NOT NULL AND fld034 IS NOT NULL

concepts.name: Foil
concepts.definition: Foil availability; powerful foil when both foil columns are non-null.
concepts.filter: fld006 IS NOT NULL AND fld007 IS NOT NULL

concepts.name: Color
concepts.definition: The color identity letter of the card.

concepts.name: CardType
concepts.definition: The card type (e.g., Artifact).

concepts.name: Supertype
concepts.definition: The supertype of the card.

concepts.name: Subtype
concepts.definition: The subtype of the card.

concepts.name: CardSet
concepts.definition: The set/expansion the card belongs to.

concepts.name: Language
concepts.definition: The language of the card printing.

concepts.name: Translation
concepts.definition: A translated name for the card/set; non-null means a translation exists.

concepts.name: FormatLegality
concepts.definition: Legality status of a card in a format.
aliases: formats in which these cards are legal

concepts.name: CommanderLegality
concepts.definition: Legality of a card in the Commander format.

concepts.name: BannedCard
concepts.definition: A card that is banned in some format.

concepts.name: Ruling
concepts.definition: A ruling entry associated with a card.

concepts.name: AvailabilityOutsideUS
concepts.definition: Flag indicating the card is only available outside the US.
aliases: only available outside the United States

concepts.name: TriggeredAbilityText
concepts.definition: Card text containing 'triggered ability'.

caveats.statement: Power can be '*' or NULL, so numeric comparisons on fld055 will miss unknown/infinite power cards.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld055 = '*' OR fld055 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Language is stored in tab02, not tab01; joining is required to filter by language.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab02 WHERE fld075 = 'Italian'

caveats.statement: Translation existence is indicated by non-null fld094 in tab05; NULL means no translation.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab05 WHERE fld094 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Legality status values include 'Legal' and 'Banned'; filtering only 'Legal' excludes banned cards.
Foil columns fld006 and fld007 must both be non-null to count as a powerful foil; one null means not powerful.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld006 IS NOT NULL AND fld007 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Availability outside US flag fld083 = 1 means only outside US; 0 or NULL means not restricted.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab04 WHERE fld083 = 1
